description.value:
Frequency 1/day

Duration 1 minute

Tap a bound fragment for darkvision or 30-foot tremorsense, or a clairvoyant glimpse of a location you've previously been.

cinderfall.incomplete: Bucket 3 -- a limited-use activated action granting a temporary new sense/utility choice. Even though the Sense-granting halves are individually trivial, the bucket-3 rule holds regardless: this hands the actor a wholly new one-shot usable ability. The clairvoyance branch additionally has no rule-element equivalent at all (Foundry clairvoyance is a spell effect with its own implementation, not a stat).
